title: chat: Space/join refers to invite roles SpaceInvite lacks
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md:1408 (Space/join): 'The caller is assigned no roles beyond @everyone unless the invite specifies otherwise.' SpaceInvite has no role property, so an invite cannot specify otherwise. Either add a roleIds property to SpaceInvite or delete the clause. Found while writing jmap-chat-vc-guide.md §5 (bead dqe3).
close_reason: Deleted 'unless the invite specifies otherwise' from Space/join; invites carry no roles (bearer token)
